reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and I always forget pills at home. Having the 2 capsules already counted in a sachet I can toss in my bag is what gets me, and $24.99 for the first box is an easy thing to try once.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? I also don't love 'Made in China', so the named U.S. lab report needs to really be there.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report for the batch was not actually on the page or the QR code did not work, I would pass.
